mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, use_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM favorite_tagss WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY use_count DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT name, use_count, create_time, update_time, DATEDIFF(NOW(), update_time) as days_since_last_use FROM favorite_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY use_count DESC, update_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM favorite_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_count > 0

SELECT name, use_count, CASE WHEN use_count >= 50 THEN 'xl' WHEN use_count >= 20 THEN 'lg' WHEN use_count >= 10 THEN 'md' WHEN use_count >= 5 THEN 'sm' ELSE 'xs' END as size_class, ROUND(use_count * 100.0 / (SELECT MAX(use_count) FROM favorite_tags WHERE user_id = #{userId}), 2) as weight FROM favorite_tag WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_count > 0 ORDER BY use_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t2.name as related_tag, COUNT(1) as co_occurrence_count, ROUND(COUNT(1) * 100.0 / t1_total.total_count, 2) as co_occurrence_rate FROM ( SELECT f1.id, f1.tags FROM favorites f1 WHERE f1.user_id = #{userId} AND f1.is_available = 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(f1.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tagName})) ) f1_with_tag CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(f1_with_tag.tags, '$[*]' COLUMNS (tag_name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$')) jt JOIN favorite_tags t2 ON t2.name = jt.tag_name AND t2.user_id = #{userId} CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) as total_count FROM favorites f_total WHERE f_total.user_id = #{userId} AND f_total.is_available = 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(f_total.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tagName})) ) t1_total WHERE jt.tag_name != #{tagName} GROUP BY t2.name, t1_total.total_count ORDER BY co_occurrence_count DESC, co_occurrence_rate DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(f.create_time) as date, COUNT(1) as usage_count FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.is_available = 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(f.tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tagName})) AND f.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(f.create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
